result.description: Orchid Nova 27QX is a fictional 27-inch creative studio display built for color grading, illustration, and desktop publishing. It features a 2560x1440 IPS panel, 99% DCI-P3 coverage, USB-C video input with 65W power delivery, and an adjustable stand for long editing sessions. Designed as a premium productivity monitor rather than a gaming or storage product, it emphasizes accurate color, soft glow reduction, and quiet operation.
